headline: Zen Technologies reports Q2 net profit up 51% to ₹90 crore
hook: Profit rises 50 percent on doubled revenue
summary: Zen Technologies reported a 50.7% year-on-year increase in net profit to ₹90 crore for the second quarter, alongside revenue nearly doubling to ₹345 crore. EBITDA rose sharply to ₹132 crore compared to ₹65 crore in the same period last year. The company's EBITDA margin also saw an improvement, moving up to 38.2% from 37.3%. Retail investors holding defense sector stocks can gauge the company's execution capabilities through these earnings.
whats_next: Upcoming quarterly earnings or order book disclosures
why_it_matters: Strong quarterly performance boosts sentiment for defense sector holdings.
winners_losers: Zen Technologies shareholders gain / none hurt
